notes: A.1 item 90 (15.3 rule 14). Documented VOLUNTARILY - A.1 exempts this element from the documentation obligation - because three different substituted values were in play across the corpus and a golden may not pin an unwritten determination. The determination is one rule for every intrinsic: the ZERO VALUE of the returned type, and the CLASS follows from what determines the returned LENGTH. Numeric 0. A boolean item's zero positions. Alphanumeric/national SPACES where the length is fixed by something that survives the rejection - one space for the fixed one-character CHAR/CHAR-NATIONAL (the function fixes it), and one space for LOCALE-DATE/LOCALE-TIME/LOCALE-TIME-FROM-SECONDS (15.52.4/15.53.4/15.54.4 r3 make the length depend on the LOCALE, which rejecting argument-1 leaves intact; one rather than a locale width because L10's culture patterns vary with the value too, so 15.30.3 r1's 'one alphanumeric space character' for an alphanumeric function whose contents are absent is adopted). A ZERO-LENGTH value only where the returned length derives from the REJECTED argument. kb/Work PB383 added BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER to both arms and its witness l1_argument_default_boolean_length. kb/Work PB470 added the locale class and its two witnesses: the four CobolLocale guards had answered a zero-length value, which no golden could contradict because 14.6.8.5 space-fills a receiver from a zero-length sender - so both witnesses read the reference DIRECTLY, a bracketed DISPLAY (14.9.11.4 GR1) beside a FUNCTION LENGTH read-out (15.50.4 r3), across all four guards and in two editions. Three mechanisms now, each one expression so a raise and its substitute cannot drift: ArgumentError (numeric zero), ArgumentErrorZeroLength and ArgumentErrorSpaces over the one pair of class values in ArgumentSubstitute, which a bool screening predicate's caller reads directly.
